name: Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 5
removable: No (permanently converted: flameproof enclosure around the iPad, not to be opened in a hazardous location; bottom cover opened outside the Ex area only for charging and SIM)
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 5 is a standard iPad mini (5th generation) converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1 under ATEX and IECEx. It is a flameproof (Ex d) design, and the tablet runs iPadOS 26. It has been discontinued; the Atexxo Zone 1 iPad mini 6 replaces it.

atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2021-12-16), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not found

safety.conditions: Ta −20 to +50°C. Repair of flameproof joints not allowed. Minimum screw property class A4-70; only original parts. Glass window to be protected from impact energy above 2 J. Device shall not be opened in a hazardous location. Battery charging only allowed outside the hazardous location. The M10x1 opening shall always be closed with a certified Ex d blind plug.
safety.peripherals: Bottom plug removable by the user to charge in a safe area; M10x1 opening must be closed with a certified Ex d blind plug

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least March 2024 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 7.9-inch Retina IPS LCD, P3, True Tone, antireflective coating
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top (sleep/wake) button, volume buttons, Home button with Touch ID; no programmable hardware key
